user.title: New daily challenge
user.description: Track a daily amount, for example 20 push-ups per day.

data_description.name: Must be unique among your challenges.
data_description.unit: Pick a suggestion or type your own unit.
data_description.daily_target: Amount you want to reach every day.
data_description.start_date: First day of the challenge. Cannot be in the future.
data_description.end_date: Optional last day of the challenge.
data_description.steps: Up to 3 amounts in ascending order. Each one gets a + button; the smallest one is also used for the − button.
data_description.streak_rule: When a day counts towards your streak.
data_description.deficit_mode: What happens when you fall behind.

source.name: Automatic counting
source.description: Take today's value from another entity, for example a step counter.

data_description.source_entity: Optional. Leave empty to count by hand.
data_description.source_mode: Daily value: the source shows today's amount and sets it; the buttons are not available then. Counter: the source keeps rising and every increase is added.

milestone_settings.name: Milestones
milestone_settings.description: Fire an event when the challenge reaches a milestone.

data_description.milestones: Without a selection there is no milestone event.

error.name_exists: A challenge with this name already exists.
error.invalid_target: The daily target must be a whole number from 1 to 100000.
error.start_in_future: The start date cannot be in the future.
error.end_before_start: The end date must be after the start date.
error.invalid_steps: Enter 1 to 3 whole numbers from 1 to 100000.
error.steps_not_ascending: Steps must be unique and in ascending order.
error.source_is_challenge: An entity of Daily Challenge cannot be the source.

add.name: Add amount
add.description: Adds an amount to a day of a challenge. The result never drops below 0.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount to add. Negative values subtract.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to update. Defaults to today.

set.name: Set value
set.description: Sets the value of a day of a challenge. 0 removes the entry.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to update. Defaults to today.

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Returns the daily values, targets and streak fulfilment of a challenge.

start.name: Start
start.description: First day to return. Defaults to the start date of the challenge.

end.name: End
end.description: Last day to return. Defaults to today.
